diagrams.title: **The journey in this section
diagrams.caption: **The journey in this section.** Each step reuses the one before it. By step 6 you know the three ways to write a tool, and when to reach for each.
diagrams.svg:

diagrams.title: **Without tools, even the best model is a very expensive chatbot
diagrams.caption: **Without tools, even the best model is a very expensive chatbot.** Everything in red needs the agent to reach outside itself: an API, a database, a file. That reach is what a tool gives it.

diagrams.title: **Tells you how vs does it for you
diagrams.caption: **Tells you how vs does it for you.** Without tools, an agent is an LLM chatbot that explains how *you* could find the answer. With tools, it finds the answer itself.
diagrams.svg:

diagrams.title: **LLM, agent and tools
diagrams.caption: **LLM, agent and tools.** The LLM never touches a tool directly. It asks; the agent runs the tool and brings the result back.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 300" aria-label="Three roles: the LLM is the brain, responsible for reasoning and decisions. The agent is the coordinator, responsible for coordination and orchestration. The tools are the hands and senses, responsible for execution and action. The agent sits between the LLM and the tools." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
        <rect x="40" y="36" width="280" height="96" rx="18" class="brain" style="fill:#FFF1CC;stroke:#B07600;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="180" y="94" text-anchor="middle" class="tl" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:24px;font-weight:700">LLM</text>
        <rect x="410" y="36" width="280" height="96" rx="18" class="agent" style="fill:#19203F;stroke:#19203F;stroke-width:2"></rect><text x="550" y="94" text-anchor="middle" class="tl on-agent" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#F2F4F8;font-size:24px;font-weight:700">Agent</text>
        <rect x="780" y="36" width="280" height="96" rx="18" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="920" y="94" text-anchor="middle" class="tl" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:24px;font-weight:700">Tools</text>
        <path d="M322 84 H406" class="ln" marker-start="url(#ah)" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path>
        <path d="M692 84 H776" class="ln" marker-start="url(#ah)" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path>
        <text x="180" y="170" text-anchor="middle" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">the brain</text>
        <text x="550" y="170" text-anchor="middle" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">the coordinator</text>
        <text x="920" y="170" text-anchor="middle" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">the hands and senses</text>
        <line x1="180" y1="184" x2="180" y2="214" class="ln dash" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none;stroke-dasharray:7 7"></line><line x1="550" y1="184" x2="550" y2="214" class="ln dash" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none;stroke-dasharray:7 7"></line><line x1="920" y1="184" x2="920" y2="214" class="ln dash" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none;stroke-dasharray:7 7"></line>
        <text x="180" y="244" text-anchor="middle" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">understands requests,</text><text x="180" y="268" text-anchor="middle" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">reasons, picks tools</text>
        <text x="550" y="244" text-anchor="middle" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">passes messages, runs</text><text x="550" y="268" text-anchor="middle" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">tools, keeps it all moving</text>

diagrams.title: **Five families of tools
diagrams.caption: **Five families of tools.** A real agent usually mixes several: a support agent might retrieve (order lookup), compute (refund maths) and act (issue the refund).
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 560" aria-label="Five families of tools. Information retrieval: web search, database queries, file reading, API clients, document retrieval with RAG. Action execution: email and messaging, file writing, database updates, APIs that create or update, scheduling. Computation: calculators, code execution, data analysis, statistics. Integration: AWS services, third-party connectors, enterprise systems, chat apps. Specialised: images, audio, video, model inference, language processing." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <rect x="20" y="20" width="340" height="250" rx="18" class="data" style="fill:#E1E9FC;stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
        <text x="44" y="58" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Information retrieval</text>
        <text x="44" y="96" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">• Web search engines</text><text x="44" y="126" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">• Database queries</text><text x="44" y="156" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">• File reading</text><text x="44" y="186" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">• API clients for outside services</text><text x="44" y="216" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">• Document retrieval (RAG)</text>

diagrams.title: **Three ingredients, three jobs
diagrams.caption: **Three ingredients, three jobs.** The decorator makes it a tool, the type hints say what to send, the docstring says when to use it. The function body is private: the model only ever sees the spec and the result.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 470" aria-label="Anatomy of a tool. The @tool decorator registers the function as a tool. The type hints become the input schema, saying server_url is a string. The docstring becomes the description that tells the model when to use the tool. Together they form the tool spec the model sees." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah-tool" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-tool" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-data" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-data" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-brain" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-brain" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
        <rect x="20" y="20" width="620" height="430" rx="16" style="fill:#1B2136"></rect>
        <rect x="30" y="44" width="600" height="28" rx="6" style="fill:#0B7F73;opacity:.35"></rect>
        <rect x="30" y="76" width="600" height="28" rx="6" style="fill:#2958C4;opacity:.4"></rect>
        <rect x="30" y="108" width="600" height="216" rx="6" style="fill:#B07600;opacity:.28"></rect>
        <g class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;font-size:14.5px">
          <text x="44" y="64" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#F78FB3;font-size:15px">@tool</text>
          <text x="44" y="96" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#E4E8F6;font-size:15px">def check_server_status(server_url: str) -> str:</text>
          <text x="44" y="128" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#9BE29B;font-size:15px">    """Check if a server is responding by making</text>
          <text x="44" y="152" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#9BE29B;font-size:15px">    an HTTP request.</text>
          <text x="44" y="184" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#9BE29B;font-size:15px">    Args:</text>
          <text x="44" y="208" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#9BE29B;font-size:15px">        server_url: The URL of the server to check</text>
          <text x="44" y="240" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#9BE29B;font-size:15px">    Returns:</text>
          <text x="44" y="264" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#9BE29B;font-size:15px">        A message indicating whether the server</text>
          <text x="44" y="288" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#9BE29B;font-size:15px">        is up or down</text>
          <text x="44" y="312" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#9BE29B;font-size:15px">    """</text>
          <text x="44" y="352" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#E4E8F6;font-size:15px">    try:</text>
          <text x="44" y="376" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#E4E8F6;font-size:15px">        response = requests.get(server_url, timeout=5)</text>
          <text x="44" y="400" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#E4E8F6;font-size:15px">        return f"Server is up. Status code: ..."</text>
          <text x="44" y="424" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#E4E8F6;font-size:15px">    except ...: return "Server is down or unreachable"</text>
        </g>
        <rect x="690" y="24" width="390" height="76" rx="14" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
        <text x="710" y="56" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">@tool</text><text x="710" y="84" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">registers the function as a tool</text>
        <rect x="690" y="120" width="390" height="76" rx="14" class="data" style="fill:#E1E9FC;stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
        <text x="710" y="152" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Type hints → input schema</text><text x="710" y="180" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">“server_url” must be a string</text>
        <rect x="690" y="216" width="390" height="76" rx="14" class="brain" style="fill:#FFF1CC;stroke:#B07600;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
        <text x="710" y="248" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Docstring → description</text><text x="710" y="276" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">tells the model what it does and when</text>
        <path d="M632 58 H686" class="ln-tool" marker-end="url(#ah-tool)" style="stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path>
        <path d="M632 90 Q660 90 686 150" class="ln-data" marker-end="url(#ah-data)" style="stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path>
        <path d="M632 216 Q660 216 686 254" class="ln-brain" marker-end="url(#ah-brain)" style="stroke:#B07600;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path>
        <path d="M885 294 V346" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path>
        <rect x="690" y="350" width="390" height="96" rx="16" class="agent" style="fill:#19203F;stroke:#19203F;stroke-width:2"></rect>
        <text x="885" y="388" text-anchor="middle" class="t on-agent" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#F2F4F8;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">What the model sees</text>
        <text x="885" y="416" text-anchor="middle" class="ts on-agent" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#F2F4F8;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">name + description + input schema</text>
        <text x="330" y="470" text-anchor="middle" class="tx" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:14px">the body (try / except) is never shown to the model</text>
      </svg>

diagrams.title: **One request, three tool calls, nobody scripted the order
diagrams.caption: **One request, three tool calls, nobody scripted the order.** Each tool's output becomes the next tool's input, and the model is the one deciding that wiring at run time. (The quarter value is whatever the model infers "last quarter" means on the day you run it.)

diagrams.title: **Find, compute, act
diagrams.caption: **Find, compute, act.** Both chains follow the same shape: fetch something, work something out, then do something. The words on the arrows are the data the agent passes along.
